title: True Durable Archive Migration, Fenced Recovery, Crash-Safe Convergence and Audit Integrity
summary: Completes Stage 13.5 / 4.10.4 with true durable archive migration between explicitly selected roots. Immutable plans and per-item identities drive copy, verification, atomic target finalization, metadata switch and exact source cleanup under leases, fencing, conflict scopes and recorder-write guards. Crash recovery converges from every physical boundary without repeating copy, finalize, metadata switch or unlink; partial and cleanup-pending outcomes retain executable retry truth. Exact actor and permission lineage, orphan adoption and bounded audit lookup preserve liveness while failing closed on ambiguous filesystem or database evidence. Progress, speed and ETA remain backend-derived and truthful, and internal migration namespaces stay excluded from archive operations.
changelog: Adds durable asynchronous migration of finalized recordings between explicitly selected archive roots.
Materializes immutable actor, source, target, segment, path, size and identity evidence before apply.
Persists exact temporary, final and quarantine identities before every related physical mutation.
Enforces copy, verify, atomic target finalize, metadata switch and exact source cleanup ordering.
Revalidates capacity, permissions, root identity, source stability and target safety at execution time.
Coordinates migration with recorder write guards, physical-volume scopes and the common lock order.
Recovers from restart and lease loss without repeating copy, target finalize, metadata switch or source unlink.
Preserves truthful cancelled, blocked, failed, partial and cleanup-pending outcomes with executable next actions.
Allows exact cleanup continuation by the original actor or a currently authorized recovery administrator.
Scopes fencing tokens and lineage checks to the bound operation instead of comparing unrelated operations.
Converges initial-apply orphan children through atomic plan binding and exactly-once mandatory audit evidence.
Uses bounded exact database audit lookup and fair worker traversal so malformed candidates cannot starve valid work.
Derives speed and ETA only from fresh backend copy samples and clears them outside active copy phases.
Excludes the internal migration namespace from inventory, retention, auto-free, integrity and later plans.
Exposes localized bounded migration status and progress without raw exception text or internal paths.
